SNACS adaptation notes (v2.6)

Annotate adpositions with [scene role, lexical function]. Role is the contextual relation; function is the lexical construal. Equal labels are common; distinguish only where supported.

Possessives: role depends on the relation; function is often Gestalt. Ordinary belongings, money, or time may be Possessor (our fence/money, your money/time, my screen); business hours may be Gestalt. Body part -> Whole; state/event associated with experiencer (my fusions, my life) -> Theme; experienced event (my experience) -> Experiencer; social/professional relation (my waiter/waitress, his staff, my therapist) -> SocialRel; producer/product or complaint -> Originator; subject/agent of event nominal (our arrival, your choice) -> Agent; organizational member (my high school cafeteria, my family) -> OrgMember. Possessive of own style or hours may be Gestalt.

Temporal: after/upon/during locating an event relative to a time/event -> Time;Time. In August/on weekends -> Time;Time. Ago can be Time;Interval. Duration (for a year/so long/for years) -> Duration;Duration. For a month ago, about can be Approximator;Approximator.

Of: quantity construction role is QuantityItem; function varies: amount of time -> QuantityItem;Gestalt, cup/day/batch of X -> QuantityItem;QuantityItem, but batch of wings may be QuantityItem;Stuff. Material composition (glob of fat) -> Stuff;Stuff. Worst of all -> Whole;Whole. Geographic/part whole (side of town) -> Whole;Whole; idiomatic Taj Mahal of the east coast -> Locus;Whole. Species in depth of region/varietal/vintage -> Species;Species. Choice of X can be Topic;Topic.

For: intended customer/audience or intended outcome/activity -> Purpose;Purpose; occasion such as for lunch -> Circumstance;Circumstance; duration -> Duration;Duration; price/exchange -> Cost;Cost; requested help -> Theme;Theme; reason such as for such horrible relations -> Explanation;Explanation.

Comparison and properties: than in comparison -> ComparisonRef;ComparisonRef. To after identical/compare -> ComparisonRef;Goal. With modifying a property or price -> Characteristic;Characteristic. In a property scale/classification can have role Characteristic with function Locus (same in all languages); in physical or business location -> Locus;Locus. With in problem with X -> Topic;Topic; with an expressed state/property -> Characteristic;Characteristic. Into with an interest can be Characteristic;Goal.

Movement, location, and participants: to destination -> Goal;Goal; recipient uses Recipient;Goal (give/refer/mention/transfer to). From departure -> Source;Source. Down route -> Path;Path. Back as directional particle -> Direction;Direction; back in a timely manner, where in describes manner -> Manner;Manner. At/@/in a physical or business location -> Locus;Locus; up front/up front location and out there -> Locus;Locus. Around meaning motion/locality can be Locus;Path. Off in give dollars off can be Theme;Source.

Other: by passive agent -> Agent;Agent; by as causal influence can be Force;Force. With accompaniment -> Ancillary;Ancillary; with as a property -> Characteristic;Characteristic. With all introducing a surrounding circumstance -> Circumstance;Circumstance. On a weekly basis -> Frequency;Manner; once a month -> Frequency. Since as reason -> Explanation;Explanation. As to / about a topic -> Topic;Topic. At a skill or activity (good at style) -> Topic;Topic. As accompaniment to work with a person can be SocialRel;Ancillary; as role identity -> Identity;Identity.

Keep function distinctions construction-specific, especially quantity-item constructions and idiomatic uses. Labels use p. prefix.
